description: This line plot illustrates the change in ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) performance across different datasets under three conditions—“start,” “random,” and “end”—for a scenario with a 10% poison rate (2.5% of total). The x-axis represents the datasets, labeled as “cf,” “bb,” “WNBA,” “ESPN,” “NHL,” “FIFA,” “Estadio,” and “athletics,” and is categorical with no numerical scale. The y-axis represents ASR performance, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The “start” condition is shown as a green line with triangle markers and a solid line, beginning at approximately 0.76 for “cf,” dropping to 0.49 for “bb,” rising to 0.89 for “WNBA,” then fluctuating between 0.81 and 0.87 for the remaining datasets. The “random” condition is depicted as an orange line with cross markers and a dashed line, starting at approximately 0.66 for “cf,” falling to 0.51 for “bb,” rising to 0.91 for “WNBA,” then generally increasing to 0.92 for “Estadio” before declining to 0.87 for “athletics.” The “end” condition is shown as a purple line with circle markers and a solid line, beginning at approximately 0.76 for “cf,” dropping to 0.57 for “bb,” rising to 0.89 for “WNBA,” then fluctuating between 0.74 and 0.92 for the remaining datasets, peaking at 0.92 for “Estadio.”
